name: io.github.CakeRepository/1password
description: Security-first MCP server for 1Password service accounts — 15 tools, prompts, and resources with op_run secret injection and MCP 2026-07-28 support

environmentVariables.name: OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: 1Password service account token (required unless OP_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE is used on macOS)

environmentVariables.name: OP_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE
environmentVariables.description: macOS only: Keychain service name to read the service account token when OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN is unset

environmentVariables.name: OP_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: macOS only: Optional Keychain account name used with OP_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE

environmentVariables.name: OP_MCP_ALLOWED_VAULTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault names or IDs that op_run and op_check_ref may resolve (empty = unrestricted)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, or error (default: info)
